title: Consolidate skeleton continuation and direction-resolution helpers
description:
## Summary
Remove duplicated skeleton/animation helper mechanics that can diverge between runtime pose resolution, editor rig visualization, and skeleton inference.

## Scope
- Establish one authoritative continuation-child resolver for `PoseRotationResolver` and `RigDebugView`, including explicit source-part, mirror-side, endpoint, and deterministic tie-break semantics.
- Establish one shared degenerate-direction/look-rotation policy with named tolerances for the applicable skeleton and pose call sites.
- Add parity coverage for equivalent runtime and editor-resolution inputs, degenerate directions, terminal bones, mirrored children, and deterministic ordering.
- Keep segment-projection mechanics under TSK-0105 and keep semantic policy in the concrete owner. Do not introduce a generic skeleton service layer or a `BoneId` value-type migration in this task.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Runtime and debug visualization use the same continuation-child decision for the same `SkeletonSnapshot`.
- Direction normalization, fallback axes, and epsilon units are centralized or explicitly documented where policies are intentionally different.
- Existing pose rotations, mirror behavior, terminal orientation, and debug output remain unchanged for current fixtures.
- Focused runtime and editor tests cover the divergent cases identified by the audit.

## Validation
Run whole-project .NET compilation before focused runtime and editor tests. Perform the relevant Unity EditMode/PlayMode checks after compilation and inspect the Unity console. Do not claim editor validation from source inspection.

## Findings
The 2026-09-09 skeleton/animation deep dive found three continuation-child implementations with different match rules and three look-rotation implementations with two hardcoded epsilon values. These are P2 divergence risks. The deep dive also identified lower-priority segment projection, body-rig loop, bone-id, and documentation cleanup; those remain in existing consolidation scope or the report as deferred P3 items.

## Blockers
Unity execution is unavailable during this reconciliation. The task remains Backlog until focused parity evidence exists.

## Next Step
Inventory the exact call-site contracts and write parity tests before extracting either helper.

## User Mandate
> "Review all of the recent audits and synthesize them into the approriate memorysmith tasks. Note that external synthesis has been done on some of these, but the external agents lacked memorysmith integration, so the tasks themselves may be very outdated compared to the state. Please check and make sure all of the audits have been fully ingested and turned into tasks as appropriate"

STRICT. Preserve full recent-audit ingestion, reconcile stale task state against current source, and do not claim Unity validation without execution.
